question: What are the key risks for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces a highly fragmented ESG reporting landscape.
beats.headline: FRAGMENTED LANDSCAPE
beats.action: A paper map lands flat and tears into mismatched strips that drift apart and hold.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex faces a highly fragmented ESG reporting landscape.

beats.line: Standards vary by jurisdiction and industry, straining data quality.
beats.headline: DATA QUALITY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the torn strips gather into stacked sheets over grid paper.
beats.delivery: Standards vary by jurisdiction and industry, straining data quality.

beats.line: Fail on auditable data, and credibility with clients suffers.
beats.headline: CREDIBILITY
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the stacked sheets compress into one document; a rubber stamp presses down and lifts, leaving a blank mark.
beats.delivery: Fail on auditable data, and credibility with clients suffers.

beats.line: Interoperability and data traceability will be critical to keep trust.
beats.headline: TRACEABILITY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the panels flatten into grid paper; pins drop in and string threads between them, pulling taut.
beats.delivery: Interoperability and data traceability will be critical to keep trust.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% TO $2.0M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the string snaps upright into a paper bar chart; a torn arrow climbs it and holds at the top.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.

beats.line: But the market questions how repeatable that growth really is.
beats.headline: REPEATABLE?
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the arrow folds into two sheets, one-off and recurring, held apart by a paper clip.
beats.delivery: But the market questions how repeatable that growth really is.

beats.line: Strategy leans on acquisitions, so integration is the key risk.
beats.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the clipped sheets rise into two paper buildings; tape strips stretch between them and hold unevenly.
beats.delivery: Strategy leans on acquisitions, so integration is the key risk.

beats.line: Adoption stays uneven, and smaller firms may delay on cost.
beats.headline: UNEVEN ADOPTION
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the taped join unrolls into a calendar strip; coins slide back off its later months and stop.
beats.delivery: Adoption stays uneven, and smaller firms may delay on cost.

beats.line: So Diginex must streamline onboarding and demonstrate clear return on investment.
beats.headline: SHOW ROI
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the calendar strip folds into a single document; a paper hand enters and rests on it.
beats.delivery: So Diginex must streamline onboarding and demonstrate clear return on investment.

raw.line: ESG regulation keeps evolving; definitions and frameworks continue to shift.
raw.headline: SHIFTING RULES
raw.action: The previous chip is covered as the stamp unfolds into sliding paper panels that slip past each other and settle misaligned.
raw.delivery: Regulation keeps evolving; definitions and frameworks continue to shift.
